missions.title: The Wolves Gather I
missions.description: Dozens of days after the mind breaking of M4A1, the AR Team is attacked by a Jupiter Cannon bombardment while coming back from a visit. They must find a way out in this world of ice and snow.

missions.title: The Wolves Gather II
missions.description: After confirming the current situation of being hungry, cold, and deep in enemy territory, the AR Team continues their search for a comms station in an attempt to establish contact with Helian...

missions.title: The Wolves Gather III
missions.description: The AR Team struggles to find a resupply station in this terrible weather. Coincidentally, they receive a new mission: search for an important T-Doll survivor.

missions.title: The Wolves Gather IV
missions.description: Sangvis Ringleader Gager discovers the AR Team and places the entire area on lockdown. With the darkness of the night quickly approaching, the AR Team begins their final breakthrough...

missions.title: Lighting Curfew I
missions.description: That night, UMP45 received an assignment from Helian. The task is to head towards the Sangvis Ferri Jupiter Cannon testing grounds to rescue the AR Team that has been MIA until now.

missions.title: Lighting Curfew II
missions.description: On the other side, HK416 and G11 have also started their operation. Their task is to provide cover for 45 and 9 and then link up afterwards.

missions.title: Lighting Curfew III
missions.description: Under the cover of darkness, the members of the 404 Squad regroups together. 45 prepares to investigate a safe house that was used by the AR Team to assess the current situation.

missions.title: Lighting Curfew IV
missions.description: Another Sangvis Ringleader, Architect, discovered the whereabouts of the 404 Squad, exactly as 45 had planned. Operation Breakthrough and Rescue starts now.

missions.title: Operation Homecoming I
missions.description: The AR Team and the 404 Squad have successfully linked up, but the crisis is still far from being resolved. Commander RO has decided to find a safe location to reestablish communications with Grifon first.

missions.title: Operation Homecoming II
missions.description: We are still very far off from the exfil Heliport. 45 suggests we eliminate Sangvis Ferri's ability to monitor the area first to ensure that we can get away safely.

missions.title: Operation Homecoming III
missions.description: Sangvis has stepped up their encirclement operations. The AR Team must seize the moment to collect enough supplies to evacuate.

missions.title: Operation Homecoming IV
missions.description: RO accepts 45's plan for evacuation under worsening conditions. But...do things really always go as planned?

missions.title: Down the Rabbit Hole
missions.description: Though the AR Team survived the crisis, Persica has made a final request - to capture a Jupiter mortar. Defend against the Sangvis onslaught while the mission is underway!
